items.alt: A heavy oil barrel rides a buckling Sensex bull as investors worry and a foreign trader departs toward US bonds.
An older woman cuts a rope attached to a huge data parcel while holding a feature phone beside a calendar marked 30.
A smiling robot conceals two working tool arms as a safety examiner spots them in a mirror and holds its disconnected plug.
A specialty-drug vial with an Indian tricolour sash passes through a 0% gate beside a giant 100% customs stamp and a medicine carton.
